<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="storySky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#455154"/>
      <stop offset="0.48" stop-color="#A4AAB2"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3E5155"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shadeTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".72"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shadeBottom" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".78"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#storySky)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".14"/>

  <circle cx="302" cy="238" r="43" fill="#FFA800" opacity=".86"/>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="230" fill="url(#shadeTop)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="470" width="390" height="374" fill="url(#shadeBottom)"/>

  <rect x="12" y="12" width="366" height="3" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF59"/>

  <text x="62" y="95" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF80">4h ago</text>

  <text x="32" y="732" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF80">A little time outside makes everything better.</text>

  <path d="M348 765 C340 756 326 763 326 774 C326 786 348 797 348 797 C348 797 370 786 370 774 C370 763 356 756 348 765 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="40" y="786" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF80">Reply to Martha...</text>
  <circle cx="375" cy="821" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="371,821 378,817 376,825" fill="#000000"/>

  <rect x="145" y="833" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
